## Election History

### 2002 Deputies Election

Election for the role of Deputy of [St Martin](https://flow.je/elections/st-martin) (1 seat), 27th November 2002.

**Christopher Blackstone was not elected**.

1,270 votes (inc. 6 spoilt papers)
